_comment_: Run config with the Phase-5 pre-write chart-of-accounts (COA) gate. The `coa_validation` block validates every posting account against ONE legal entity's Zoho Books chart before the journal export is written; any missing / unknown / inactive / DO-NOT-USE / non-leaf / out-of-scope account is diverted to review instead of posting. One entity per run. Paths resolve relative to THIS file's directory. Real org_ids + the Books COA JSON are sensitive client config: they live in the private brisken-config repo (BLUEPRINT 5.3/5.4), never in the public repo.

zoho._: Chart source for the categorizer + export account resolution. 'api' pulls live (creds from env); 'csv' reads a local export. Separate from coa_validation below, which is the pre-write postability gate.

coa_validation._: Pre-write COA postability gate. chart_path -> the multi-entity Books COA JSON; org_id -> which entity's chart to validate against; scope_groups -> the approved card-expense root groups (accounts outside them are diverted to review). Real values live in brisken-config; the placeholders below show the shape only.
